fields.notes: SD has no formal DFT / scan architecture exposed at the bus interface. Tuning (CMD19) + SPI loopback are the only protocol-level observability features. Internal NAND test is vendor-specific.

exposed_dft_features.name: CMD19 SEND_TUNING_BLOCK
exposed_dft_features.purpose: UHS-I sampling-point calibration; functionally a lane-deskew DFT.

exposed_dft_features.name: Loopback via SPI mode
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Software self-test path with CRC enable (CMD59).

exposed_dft_features.name: CSR error bits
exposed_dft_features.purpose: All detected protocol errors reported in R1.

fields.no_jtag_on_edge_connector: There is no JTAG / scan / boundary-scan port on the SD card edge connector. Vendor SiP debug uses internal JTAG accessed at wafer/package probe, not over the SD bus.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
